item.title: Odessa Permian Teacher Charged With Kidnapping
item.description: ODESSA, TX — An Odessa Permian High School teacher was arrested Tuesday after deputies discovered a missing 15-year-old student at her home, according to the Ector County Sheriff’s Office.Tracie Annette Garza, 53, was charged with kidnapping and taken into custody without incident. item.title: San Angelo Fisherman Catches First-Ever Legacy ShareLunker From Hords Creek
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — San Angelo fisherman Wendell Ramsey caught the first-ever Legacy Class ShareLunker from Hords Creek Reservoir last week.Ramsey reeled in a 13.76-pound bass from the Coleman County lake, which is located about 60 miles northeast of San Angelo.Fish that are 13 pounds or larger qualify for Legacy ShareLunker status. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 13 Texas Tech Loses Toppin for the Year to a Torn ACL
item.description: LUBBOCK, TX — Texas Tech forward JT Toppin will miss the remainder of the season after an MRI confirmed he suffered a torn ACL in his right knee during Tuesday night’s game at Arizona State, the Tech basketball team announced on Wednesday.Toppin, a junior and four-time Big 12 Player of the Week this season, has been one of the nation’s top performers. He leads the country with 234 made field goals and averages 21.8 points, 10.8 rebounds and 1.7 blocks per game. Learn More Here.

item.title: Wall's Gage Reichenau Signs With North Central Texas College
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Wall Hawks ace pitcher and the reigning MVP of 3A baseball, Gage Reichenau, signed to play college baseball at North Central Texas College on Wednesday. In front of a packed gym at Wall High School, Reichenau put pen to paper to fulfill one of his lifelong dreams to play at the next level. Reichenau and head coach Jeremy Gordon gave their thoughts on the signing after the festivities ended. Watch those interviews above. Learn More Here.

item.title: Former Texas Top 10 Most Wanted Criminal Illegal Immigrant Sentenced
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — A Honduran national previously listed among Texas’ 10 Most Wanted Criminal Illegal Immigrants has been sentenced to 38 years in prison after being convicted of continuous sexual assault of a child in Harris County, authorities said.Jose Miguel Zelaya-Ponce, 22, was found guilty on enhanced charges and sentenced Jan. 13, 2026, to confinement in the Texas Department of Criminal Justice. Learn More Here.

item.title: WATCH: No. 11 Angelo State Returns Home to Face Oklahoma Christian
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The No. 11 Angelo State baseball team returns home this weekend to host Oklahoma Christian in a four-game Lone Star Conference series beginning Friday at Foster Field at 1st Community Credit Union Stadium.First pitch is scheduled for 6:30 p.m. Friday. The teams will play a doubleheader Saturday at 4 p.m. and 7 p.m., followed by the series finale at 1 p.m. Sunday. Learn More Here.

item.title: Sheriff Responds to Shooting in Veribest
item.description: VERIBEST, TX — Authorities say the scene of a shooting Wednesday evening in Veribest has been cleared, the area is safe, and a suspect is believed to be contained elsewhere. The Tom Green County Sheriff's Office issued an alert referring to "recent police activity in Veribest," declaring the area cleared and safe. Tom Green County Sheriff Nick Hanna stated that the medical condition of any victim remains unknown as the investigation is rapidly unfolding Learn More Here.
